newsitem.title: CANADA: Imasco shrs fall with U.S. tobacco stocks.
newsitem.headline: Imasco shrs fall with U.S. tobacco stocks.

text.p: Imasco Ltd dropped in brisk trading on Thursday, dragged lower by battered shares in U.S. tobacco producers.

Philip Morris Cos Inc fell early on news that U.S. state attorneys general were close to settling with Brooke Group Ltd's Liggett unit, which would see the company hand over some potentially damaging documents against the tobacco industry.
Heavily weighted Philip Morris shed 5 to 117 on the New York Stock Exchange and helped shave several points off the Dow Jones Industrial Average.
Imasco was down 1.30 at 36.60 on turnover of 560,040 shares on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
"We are following the (Liggett) story closely. But for Imasco, these issues are far less important than for U.S. companies," said ScotiaMcLeod Inc consumer products analyst Steven Holt.
"There's no government-sponsored litigation going on in this country nor is there anything imminent that we know of," he added.
Holt said that at those levels, he would advise investors to buy Imasco. He had already had a buy on the stock with a 12-month target in the mid-40s.
